title: Detection-Efficient Watermarking for Vision--Language Agents via Risk-Constrained Strength Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21488v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision--language agents generate descriptions, decisions, and instructions that may be reused by users, downstream agents, and automated workflows, creating a need for provenance mechanisms that support content authenticity and post-deployment auditing without unnecessarily degrading response quality. We present a risk-aware semantic watermarking framework that combines predictive uncertainty with a zero-shot multimodal relevance-risk proxy to allocate watermark strength during decoding. A single risk penalty $\lambda$ exposes a continuous operating frontier, allowing deployment-time selection of a detection--quality trade-off without model retraining. At a selected operating point, mean watermark strength is reduced by approximately 59.4\% relative to fixed-strength watermarking, while perplexity change falls from 0.3634 to 0.1689 and clean/paraphrased ROC-AUC reaches 0.9552/0.9459. translated_title: 基于风险约束强度分配的视觉-语言智能体高效检测水印方法
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言智能体生成的描述、决策和指令可能会被用户、下游智能体和自动化工作流重复使用，因此需要能够支持内容真实性与部署后审计的溯源机制，同时避免不必要地降低响应质量。我们提出了一种风险感知的语义水印框架，该框架将预测不确定性与零样本多模态相关性风险代理相结合，在解码过程中动态分配水印强度。单一的风险惩罚参数 λ 提供了一个连续的操作前沿，使得可以在部署时选择检测-质量权衡方案，而无需重新训练模型。在选定的操作点上，平均水印强度相对于固定强度水印降低了约59.4%，同时困惑度变化从0.3634降至0.1689，原始/改写文本的ROC-AUC分别达到0.9552/0.9459。匹配强度分析表明，这一优势……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种风险感知的语义水印框架，通过结合预测不确定性与零样本多模态相关性风险代理在解码时动态分配水印强度，在保持高检测准确率（ROC-AUC达0.955）的同时将平均水印强度降低约59.4%并显著减少文本质量损失，且无需重新训练模型即可灵活调节检测与质量之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a risk-aware semantic watermarking framework that dynamically allocates watermark strength during decoding by combining predictive uncertainty with a zero-shot multimodal relevance-risk proxy, reducing mean watermark strength by ~59.4% while maintaining high detection accuracy (ROC-AUC 0.955) and enabling retraining-free deployment-time selection of the detection-quality trade-off.
